name: Rite of Seeking
text: Uses (3 charges). [action] Spend 1 charge: Investigate. Investigate using [willpower] instead of [intellect]. If you succeed, discover 1 additional clue at this location. If a [skull], [cultist], [tablet], [elder_thing], or [auto_fail] symbol is revealed during this test, after this test resolves lose all remaining actions and immediately end your turn.
text_cn: 使用(3充能)。 [action]花费1充能：调查。这次调查不使用[intellect]，改为使用[willpower]。如果成功，额外发现所在地点1个线索。如果检定中抽出[skull]、[cultist]、[tablet]、[elder_thing]或[auto_fail]标记，在检定结束后，失去所有剩余行动，并立刻结束你的回合。
